en_title: GTA 6 Dev Honors Late Mother With In-Game Memorial That Players Can Visit
cn_title: 《GTA 6》开发者在游戏中设立纪念碑缅怀已故母亲，玩家可以前往探访
opus_summary: Rockstar质量保证开发者Matt Green透露，《GTA6》在Leonida的一处纪念碑上收录了他已故母亲的名字，玩家可以前往探访。制作设计师Terrance Radcliff也表示，他在游戏开发期间离世的父亲和女儿同样被铭记于游戏中。

paragraphs.en: A GTA 6 developer has paid tribute to his late mother with an in-game memorial in Leonida that players can find and visit themselves.
paragraphs.cn: 一名《GTA 6》开发者在游戏中的Leonida设立了一座纪念碑，缅怀已故的母亲，玩家可以自行找到并前往探访。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games QA developer Matt Green shared the touching story of how his mother helped launch his career in game development and the way she was honored in the Grand Theft Auto universe with a post on Instagram. Although she passed eight months before GTA 6's launch last week, Rockstar still managed to include her in a wall of other names in a memorial located in Leonida.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar质量保证开发者Matt Green在Instagram上发帖，分享了母亲如何帮助他开启游戏开发职业生涯的感人故事，以及她在《侠盗猎车手》世界中受到缅怀的方式。尽管她在上周《GTA 6》发售的八个月前去世，Rockstar还是设法将她的名字与其他人的名字一同刻在了Leonida一座纪念碑的墙上。

paragraphs.en: "As a kid, I remember practically begging my Mum to let me get GTA: Vice City and even though she was understandably reluctant, she caved," Green said. "I think that decision is likely what set me on the path to eventually working at Rockstar Games and on GTA VI.
paragraphs.cn: Green说：「我记得小时候，我几乎是求着妈妈让我买《GTA: Vice City》，尽管她有所顾虑也是可以理解的，但她最终还是答应了。我想，那个决定很可能让我走上了最终进入Rockstar并参与《GTA 6》开发的道路。

paragraphs.en: "She was super proud and excited to see what I'd been working on but unfortunately I never got to show her. She's been gone almost 8 months now and sometimes it still doesn't feel real."
paragraphs.cn: 「她非常自豪，也很期待看到我一直在做的东西，但遗憾的是，我始终没能给她看。她离开已经快八个月了，有时候我还是觉得这一切不真实。」

paragraphs.en: The memorial, which Green said can be found "just north of Hamlet, shows that Bev Green passed in March 2026, and she's joined by a collection of other names, too. It's unclear if every name on the memorial is tied to another Rockstar developer's lost loved one or who the names may be referencing, but we know at least two other names are.
paragraphs.cn: Green说，这座纪念碑位于「Hamlet正北边不远处」，上面显示Bev Green于2026年3月去世，旁边还有其他一些名字。目前尚不清楚纪念碑上的每个名字是否都与另一位Rockstar开发者失去的亲人有关，也不清楚这些名字可能指的是谁，但我们知道至少还有两个名字确实与开发者失去的亲人有关。

paragraphs.en: Production designer Terrance Radcliff took to X/Twitter to share how the team had immortalized his father and daughter, who both passed during GTA 6's development. Elhuntry Radcliff and Jade Radcliff can be seen next to each other in-game.
paragraphs.cn: 制作设计师Terrance Radcliff在X上分享了团队如何让他的父亲和女儿永远留在游戏中，两人都在《GTA 6》开发期间去世。在游戏中可以看到Elhuntry Radcliff和Jade Radcliff的名字并列在一起。

paragraphs.en: "To wrap up launch week, what an honor to see my Father and my first Daughter, Jade, both of who I lost during development, forever immortalized in GTA VI," Radcliff said. "To have them be a part of such a huge moment in gaming history means everything to me. Peace & blessings."
paragraphs.cn: Radcliff说：「在发售周结束之际，看到我的父亲和我的第一个女儿Jade永远留在《GTA 6》中，是多么荣幸。我在开发期间失去了他们。能让他们成为游戏史上如此重大时刻的一部分，对我来说意义非凡。愿平安与祝福相伴。」

paragraphs.en: To wrap up launch week, what an honor to see my Father and my first Daughter, Jade, both of who I lost during development, forever immortalized in GTA VI. To have them be a part of such a huge moment in gaming history means everything to me. Peace & blessings. 🙏🏽 #GTAVI https://t.co/HKOFYBiIR9
paragraphs.cn: 在发售周结束之际，看到我的父亲和我的第一个女儿Jade永远留在《GTA 6》中，是多么荣幸。我在开发期间失去了他们。能让他们成为游戏史上如此重大时刻的一部分，对我来说意义非凡。愿平安与祝福相伴。🙏🏽 #GTAVI https://t.co/HKOFYBiIR9

paragraphs.en: "I'm incredibly grateful that she's able to be honoured inside the world of VI," Green's post added. "Miss you Mum."
paragraphs.cn: Green在帖子中补充道：「我非常感激她能在《GTA 6》的世界里受到缅怀。想你，妈妈。」

paragraphs.en: With Green's guidance, we tracked down the memorial for those who would like to visit it and pay their respects. If you're looking to make a visit to pay your respects, look no further than the images below.
paragraphs.cn: 在Green的指引下，我们找到了这座纪念碑，供那些想前往探访和致意的人参考。如果你想前去致意，请看下方的图片。

paragraphs.en: We all know 13 years passed between the launches of GTA 5 and GTA 6, but we're only just now learning about the blood, sweat, and tears its team poured into bringing Leonida to life. More than a few developers took to social media to celebrate their hard work after the premiere of the Netflix Extended Look in August.
paragraphs.cn: 我们都知道，《GTA 5》和《GTA 6》的发售相隔了13年，但我们直到现在才开始了解到，团队为了让Leonida栩栩如生而付出了多少心血与泪水。在8月Netflix Extended Look首播后，不少开发者在社交媒体上庆祝他们的辛勤工作。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方攻略。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《GTA》的新系统，或通过第一章指南与提示和第二章指南与提示了解前几章的全部细节。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
